changes: Background commands now wake the editor event loop directly, even when a previous repaint is still pending.
macos: Fix capture hotkeys waiting until you click SkyImage: both the shortcut and capture result wake the app without relying on a native redraw.
Native menu, Dock reopen and Quit commands use the same wake-up path.
SkyImage retains its existing signing identity, projects, settings and GitHub update channel.
windows: MyImage is now SkyImage on Windows. Existing projects, settings and the Microsoft Store update path are unchanged.
Store-installed copies check Microsoft Store for updates available to this installation. Open the Store to update.
